_comment: G-8: every display string in the game, English only in MVP. Keys are ui_<screen>_<element> or n_<event>_title/_body (doc 08's event ids). Full table is authored alongside the screens; the entries below fix the conventions and the load-bearing templates.
_plural_rule: A template may carry a <key>_one variant, used when its count argument is exactly 1 (English needs two forms; 0 and 2+ take the base key, so the base is written in the plural). The count is the template s only numeric placeholder; a template with several names its selector in a sibling <key>_plural entry. UIConfig.t() applies this; tests/test_ui_strings.gd holds the file to it.
_source: docs/design/12-ui-ux.md §3.1 + §8. Placeholders are {named} only — never positional %s. Lookup is Str.t(key, args). A missing key returns the key itself in a debug build and is a test failure (doc 12 test 21).
n_component_tripped_body: Protection opened at {time}; it may reclose on its own.
n_incident_failed_body: It peaked at tier {tier} before it burned out.
n_land_developed_body: You can build on it now.
n_load_shed_body: {kw} kW dropped at {time} to keep the grid up.
n_road_collapsed_body: The surface failed and the lane is shut until it is rebuilt.
n_road_flooded_body: Standing water is {depth} mm deep and traffic is being turned back.
n_tax_changed_body: The new rate applies from the next settled hour.
n_treasury_critical_body: Balance {balance}. Spending is blocked until income recovers.
n_treasury_low_body: Balance {balance}. The credit line is paying your bills now.
n_water_contamination_body: Zone {zone} is under a boil notice until it clears.
n_water_main_break_body: Main {edge} is losing water. Pressure downstream falls until it is repaired.
n_water_pressure_low_body: Zone {zone} is below the pressure taps need.
n_water_pump_tripped_body: Pump {node} lost power and is waiting out its restart lockout.
n_water_zone_offline_body: Zone {zone} has no pressure at all.
n_weather_warning_body: You have about {minutes} minutes to get ready.
ui_away_capped: Your city ran for {hours}h — the maximum.
ui_away_nothing: Nothing happened worth waking you for.
ui_budget_out_of_range: That is past the end of the ladder.
ui_budget_unavailable: The treasury is not reachable right now.
ui_coach_blackout: Transformer T-04 just failed. The block behind you went dark.
ui_coach_dispatch: Tap the incident, then ASSIGN the crew with the shortest ETA.
ui_coach_look_around: Drag to look around. Pinch to zoom.
ui_coach_open_build: Tap BUILD to open the build sheet.
ui_coach_open_drawer: Open the incident drawer. Everything going wrong is listed there.
ui_coach_payoff: One part failed and four systems followed. Now keep it alive.
ui_coach_place_house: Place a house on the marked lot. That one already has power.
ui_coach_relight: The crew is rolling. Watch the lights come back.
ui_coach_transformer: Open GRID and put a transformer within three tiles of that lot.
ui_coach_unserved: Now the dark lot to the west. No transformer reaches it, so nothing can be built.
ui_coach_welcome: This is your city. It runs whether you watch it or not.
ui_dashboard_no_history: Not enough history yet — come back in an hour.
ui_drawer_empty: Nothing needs a crew right now.
ui_event_log_empty: Nothing has happened yet. Everything the city tells you is kept here.
ui_overlay_active: {name} overlay is on. Tap again to turn it off.
ui_overlay_disabled: {name} overlay: this system is not in the build yet.
ui_pause_quit_confirm: Quit? Your city is saved first.
ui_picker_empty: No unit is free. Build a station, or recall one.
ui_picker_empty_soonest: No unit is free. The soonest frees in {eta}.
ui_picker_failed: That unit could not be sent.
ui_picker_unavailable: The fleet is not reachable right now.
ui_requirement_city_level: City level too low: Level {need} required, you are Level {have}. {remedy}
ui_requirement_city_level_remedy: Grow the city to Level {need} to unlock it.
ui_requirement_e_already_road: Already paved: every tile in the selection is that road type.
ui_requirement_e_already_road_remedy: Nothing to fix - pick tiles that are not paved yet.
ui_requirement_e_austerity: Spending is frozen at the credit limit.
ui_requirement_e_austerity_remedy: Restore a positive balance to lift austerity.
ui_requirement_e_avenue: Avenue access insufficient: nearest avenue {have} tiles from the access tile / {need} tiles required for Level {level}. Upgrade this block's boundary road to an AVENUE, or build one within {need} tiles.
ui_requirement_e_avenue_one: Avenue access insufficient: nearest avenue {have} tile from the access tile / {need} tiles required for Level {level}. Upgrade this block's boundary road to an AVENUE, or build one within {need} tiles.
ui_requirement_e_avenue_remedy: Upgrade this block's boundary road to an AVENUE.
ui_requirement_e_condition: Condition too low: {have} / {need} required to upgrade. {remedy}

ui_requirement_e_level_unavailable_remed: Place it at the level the card shows, then upgrade it in place.
ui_requirement_e_main_overlap_remedy: Route around it, or start from the existing main.
ui_requirement_e_max_level: Already at Level {have} of {need} — the highest this building goes.
ui_requirement_e_max_level_remedy: Nothing to fix — this is the top of the ladder.
ui_requirement_e_no_eligible_tiles: Nothing to upgrade: the selection holds no open street. {remedy}
ui_requirement_e_no_eligible_tiles_remed: Select streets that are not closed for work.
ui_requirement_e_no_feeder: No feeder in reach: the nearest line is more than {need} tiles from tile {have}. {remedy}
ui_requirement_e_no_feeder_one: No feeder in reach: the nearest line is more than {need} tile from tile {have}. {remedy}
ui_requirement_e_no_feeder_remedy: Place it closer to an existing power line.
ui_requirement_e_no_main: No water main in reach: the nearest main is more than {need} tiles from tile {have}. {remedy}
ui_requirement_e_no_main_one: No water main in reach: the nearest main is more than {need} tile from tile {have}. {remedy}
ui_requirement_e_no_main_remedy: Lay a main toward this tile, or build closer to one.
ui_requirement_e_no_tiles_remedy: Drag across the tiles you want.

ui_requirement_e_out_of_bounds: Off the map: {have} is outside the city limits. {remedy}

ui_requirement_e_tier_locked: Arterial mains are not available yet. {remedy}
ui_requirement_e_unknown_archetype_remed: Pick a card from the build sheet.
ui_requirement_e_unknown_building: That building is no longer on the map. {remedy}
ui_requirement_e_unknown_building_remedy: Close this panel and pick another building.
ui_requirement_e_unknown_component_remed: Pick a card from the Infrastructure tab.
ui_requirement_e_unknown_road_class_reme: Choose a street or an avenue.
ui_requirement_e_unserved: No electrical service: no transformer reaches tile {have}. {remedy}

ui_requirement_e_variant_locked_remedy: This part unlocks in a later phase of the city.

ui_requirement_no_crew_one: No construction crew free: {have} / {need} crew busy. {remedy}

ui_requirement_no_road: No road access: nearest road is {have} tiles away. Build a road to this parcel.
